author: permaculturegeek
body:
Earlier on I did (early T10)  - if there was an option to avoid I'd take it, and if there was no option, I'd think long and hard about the risk. Of course the easybeats (dark slime etc) give a lot fewer shards.

When I first beat the gryphons it was on a low floor, and I died to them about five floors later. The growth of stats with floor height has since been reduced.

And now, at 241, the gryphons are a horde I readily attack. I avoid the pegasii if possible, because it's always a long drawn out fight, and the Melodiases, because you can burn through several Lyon's Penances.

author: Allalilacias
body:
It depends on your strength level. Are you strong enough to have more than 90% chance of beating them? Do you have a strategy for them? 

More often than not, getting further into the tower is better. You get more shards even for shitty enemies. However, you cannot always evade them, so you must have some strategy against all enemies.

Ideally, you finish the tower. So, while weak, avoid as many as possible, and, when strong enough, fight to your hearts content.
